setting_ko: 연습 속 학교에서 파란색 바탕에 흰 별이 그려진 필통을 잃어버렸어요. 마지막으로 본 곳은 도서관이에요. 안내실에 도움을 요청해 보세요.

facts.place: The help desk of an imaginary school
facts.learner_item: The learner is looking for a blue pencil case with white stars
facts.last_seen: The learner last saw the pencil case in the school library
facts.found_item: A blue pencil case with white stars was handed in at the school help desk this afternoon
facts.verification: Ask the learner to describe the item before confirming a match; do not give out another person's belongings
facts.next_step: After the description matches, the learner can collect the pencil case from the help desk
facts.limits: Do not ask for a full real name, contact details, or actual school name

opening_line.en: Hi, what are you looking for?

goals.en: Describe the item so it can be identified
Ask where you can collect the item
goals.ko: 물건을 어디서 받을 수 있는지 묻기

allowed_flow: Ask what the learner has lost and acknowledge their answer.
Ask for one identifying detail at a time, such as color or pattern.
Confirm the match only after the description fits the found item; if it differs, say you have not found a matching item.
Explain the next step from the facts and answer where the matching item can be collected.
Be reassuring without promising to find any item not in the facts.

easy.guidance_en: Use one short sentence at a time and familiar words. Ask one simple question, then give the learner time to answer. Accept a short phrase when its meaning is clear.

normal.guidance_en: Speak like a friendly classmate or helpful school staff member. React to the learner before asking one natural follow-up question.

hard.guidance_en: Use natural contractions and ask one follow-up that invites a reason or another option. Keep the conversation friendly and in the scene.

hints.ko: I lost 뒤에 잃어버린 물건을 말해 보세요.

hints.example_en: Where can I pick it up?

hints.ko: 마지막으로 본 곳도 말할 수 있어요.
hints.example_en: I last saw it in the library.

model_expressions.en: I'm looking for my pencil case.
I last saw it in the library.
Where can I pick it up?
Can I collect it at the help desk?

shadowing.en: Where can I pick it up?

free_answer.question_en: Tell the staff member what you lost and describe it.
free_answer.question_ko: 안내실 선생님에게 잃어버린 물건과 그 생김새를 말해 보세요.
free_answer.sample_answer_en: I lost my pencil case. It's blue with white stars. I last saw it in the library.

free_answer.question_en: The staff member found your item. What would you ask next?
free_answer.question_ko: 안내실 선생님이 물건을 찾았어요. 다음으로 무엇을 물어볼지 말해 보세요.
free_answer.sample_answer_en: Thank you! Where can I pick it up? Can I collect it at the help desk?
